provenance: Independently authored from docs/design/storage-digests.md §4.7/§4.7.2/§4.7.3; not produced by the Rust codec under test. golden-* cases are verbatim immutable D10 vectors whose digests equal the persisted tx-header 178 values.

cases.name: golden-v2-one-op
cases.note: verbatim golden.request.v2.bin from immutable D10; the generator re-derives it identically

cases.name: min-one-op
cases.note: smallest legal frame: one op, one payload byte, empty read set, no expected version

cases.name: read-set-ascending
cases.note: three read-set pairs in numeric order across two kinds

cases.name: read-set-term-max
cases.note: term read-set id at u32::MAX, encoded in 16 bytes

cases.name: expected-version
cases.note: expected_version present: flag 1 followed by u64 42

cases.name: expected-version-one
cases.note: the smallest legal expected version, because 0 means absent

cases.name: expected-version-two
cases.note: flag 1 with value 2: a legal version, distinct from an illegal presence flag of 2

cases.name: ops-two-order-preserved
cases.note: op order is part of the request: kinds are deliberately descending

cases.name: op-unknown-kind
cases.note: unregistered kind and version are legal frames with unknown semantics

cases.name: read-set-empty-declared
cases.note: read_set count 0 is legal; the ceiling is an upper bound only

cases.name: ops-many
cases.note: 32 ops exercise the count-prefixed table without a megabyte fixture
